# Phase Pull Request

## Delivery phase

Phase ID / parent milestone:
Host / branch:
Prerequisite merged PRs:

## Result

Describe the concrete behavior and acceptance criteria met. State exclusions and
compatibility or capability changes.

## Validation

Record commands, actual host/tool versions, outcomes and evidence. Identify
unrun required checks; keep the PR draft until required checks pass.

## Risks and handoff

Record residual risks, native-platform limits and resume instructions if needed.

## Review

When ready, post a **separate PR conversation comment** exactly `/grok review`.
This template text does not trigger review. Record the requested head SHA,
trigger-comment link, actual review outcome and disposition of findings here or
in PR discussion. Re-run checks and request review again after source changes.
Owner authorization is required to merge.
